model_id_source: aws bedrock list-inference-profiles --region us-east-1 (SYSTEM_DEFINED, ACTIVE, confirmed live)

live_bedrock_capability_audit.method: live Converse API calls against this exact model_id, not documentation
live_bedrock_capability_audit.probe_call_note: each probe used maxTokens<=2048 and trivial prompts; recorded here as the audit trail, not part of the experiment's own spend

findings.extended_thinking_constraint: temperature MUST be 1.0 when thinking is enabled (ValidationException otherwise) -- a real model constraint, not a bug
findings.forced_tool_choice_with_thinking_error: Thinking may not be enabled when tool_choice forces tool use.
findings.max_tokens_note: no rejection observed up to 65536; did not test higher since the experiment's own output need (research trace + <=8 selections) does not require it
findings.context_window_note: third-party sources disagree (200K-1M depending on source/date); not resolved precisely because the actual packet size (~8.2K tokens, see V8B1_EVIDENCE_PACKET_SPEC.md) is far below any plausible figure and the ambiguity does not constrain this design

chosen_configuration.temperature_note: REQUIRED to be 1.0 by the model when thinking is enabled; not a free choice -- thinking capability takes precedence over a lower-temperature preference, since reasoning depth is the stated priority ("do not intentionally cripple reasoning for cost savings")
chosen_configuration.thinking_budget_rationale: above the observed minimum (1024) and generous for a 10-phase structured research process over an ~8.2K-token packet, without maximizing purely for its own sake ("do not maximize verbose output either"); this is a considered middle setting, not the ceiling and not the floor
chosen_configuration.max_tokens_rationale: matches the existing hypothesis_engine/llm_matchup pipeline's own frozen maxTokens=8192 (bedrock_adapter.py), reused rather than re-derived, and comfortably covers a research_trace (<=20 items per array) + up to 8 selections without needing the tested-safe ceiling of 65536
chosen_configuration.tool_choice_rationale: forced tool_choice is INCOMPATIBLE with thinking on this model (see live audit above); auto is the only option that permits thinking + multi-turn search_hypotheses calls + a final submit_selections call in one session
chosen_configuration.no_forced_final_tool_consequence: a turn that ends without a submit_selections call (stopReason != tool_use with name=submit_selections after the model's final turn) is treated as an INVALID_NO_SUBMISSION outcome for that fixture -- recorded in the selection freeze's attrition ledger, never silently retried with a different setting mid-run
chosen_configuration.caching_key_construction: model_id + config version stamp + prompt_content_hash() + schema content (folded into prompt_content_hash) + packet_hash + call_index, mirroring bedrock_adapter.py's existing _cache_key pattern exactly

explicitly_not_done.settings_changed_after_first_real_call: forbidden by the no-mid-run-tuning rule; this file is frozen before the canary
